cli_description: Inspect and operate the local Codex Run Budget ledger.
cli_survey_help: read-only overview of recent local tasks
cli_survey_lifecycle_help: include up to 20 turn-lifecycle evidence rows
cli_meter_help: sense native account quotas; keep local snapshots
cli_meter_thread_help: snapshot: backend UUID (up to 8); report/tasks/estimate: exact local task filter
cli_meter_limit_help: report file limit (200) or history row limit (20)
cli_meter_baseline_help: report from a saved snapshot id (within last 1000)
cli_report_full_help: print full artifact to stdout instead of saving
cli_report_since_help: custom start; ISO timestamp with explicit UTC offset
cli_report_until_help: custom end; ISO timestamp with explicit UTC offset
cli_report_output_help: create private report; existing files are refused
cli_workflow_after_help: previous observation cursor for the exact same scope
cli_auto_report_threshold_help: optional minimum elapsed time; default 0 reports every turn
cli_show_help: show one run; use 'latest' for the newest
cli_resume_tokens_help: new absolute token ceiling, such as 200k
cli_workflow_error: run-budget: invalid workflow scope/cursor or unavailable local evidence; no scope expansion or agent action was performed
cli_report_error: run-budget: cannot create report (invalid range, source or output; existing files are never overwritten)
cli_meter_error: run-budget: cannot read meter (invalid selection, storage or native source)
cli_audit_error: run-budget: cannot audit transcripts (unreadable files or invalid selection)
cli_run_error: run-budget: operation failed; private details were not printed
run_status: Run Budget {status} (epoch {epoch}): {spent}/{maximum} observed tokens; {remaining} remaining; {tool_calls}/{max_tool_calls} tool calls; {active_agents}/{max_agents} active subagents.
workflow_old_evidence_not_proof_of_stall: Evidence is old; it cannot prove a stall
workflow_usage_delta_unavailable: Before/after Task token delta is not comparable
workflow_token_delta: Comparable before/after Token delta for {comparable} Tasks: {token_delta}.
workflow_scan_cost: Read {bytes} bytes this time; model requests {requests}.
workflow_note_local: This is an observation of local records, not native live state.
workflow_note_complete: task_complete only proves a turn ended; it is not workflow acceptance.
workflow_note_stall: No new record does not mean a stall; Token deltas are not quota or billing, and an incomplete cohort is not a total.
workflow_note_bounds: At most 256 KiB of each tail is read; tool/wait counts cover direct tail calls only, without unpacking code-mode wrappers.
workflow_note_efficiency: Efficiency requires the same scope and acceptance quality; this tool does not claim time or Token savings.
workflow_usage:
workflow observe --thread SELECTOR [--include-agents] [--after CURSOR]
workflow targets: list exact native wait_threads targets only; do not read conversations.
Default maximum is 8 Tasks; observation reports differences only and does not schedule or control agents.
workflow_selection_limited: Selection reached its limit; this is not a complete agent tree.
workflow_not_live: Native live state and workflow acceptance were not checked; no automatic intervention was taken.
